items.title: Pushforward along a finite etale morphism preserves locally constant sheaves
items.author: The Stacks Project Authors
items.source_version: Stacks Project source tree, file etale-cohomology.tex, corpus local snapshot 20261011
items.difficulty_reason: The lemma asserts that the pushforward along a finite etale morphism of schemes preserves (finite) locally constant sheaves of sets, and likewise of abelian groups and of Lambda-modules, on the small etale sites (statement lines 9972-9980). The proof is short but genuine: the author first removes the geometry by observing that f_* commutes with etale localization, and that a finite etale morphism is etale locally a disjoint union of isomorphisms (proof lines 9983-9986), which reduces the assertion to the statement that a finite product of locally constant sheaves is locally constant; the author states that reduced assertion and closes it directly (proof lines 9987-9990), the other two categories being the same argument. The non-formal content is the reduction to the local product model. The claim is H1: a short reduction followed by a direct verification.
